description: This file defines the MidiEventScheduler class, which extends EventScheduler, and manages MIDI events scheduling and dispatching using Android's MidiReceiver. It includes nested classes for handling MIDI events and a custom receiver to process MIDI messages at specified times.
external_methods: onSend(byte[] msg, int offset, int count, long timestamp)

classes.name: MidiEventScheduler
classes.description: Main class responsible for scheduling MIDI events and interfacing with Android's MidiReceiver.

classes.name: MidiEvent
classes.description: Inner class representing a scheduled MIDI event, extending SchedulableEvent, used for holding MIDI message data and timing.

methods.name: createScheduledEvent
methods.description: Creates a MidiEvent object from MIDI message data, either by reusing an event from the pool or constructing a new one.

methods.name: addEventToPool
methods.description: Returns MidiEvent objects to the pool for reuse, based on their data size.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Provides access to the internal MidiReceiver instance for receiving MIDI messages.
